sentences.text:
The Petitioners seek to quash F.I.R. No.583 of 2017 registered at Goregaon Police Station for
offences under Sections 498A, 406 r/w. 34 of Indian Penal Code.

2.  The aforesaid crime was registered pursuant to the First 48-WP-2051-2023.odt Information Report lodged by Respondent No.2, the wife of the Petitioner Nikunj (Petitioner in Writ Petition No.9448 of 2023).
The Petitioners in Writ Petition No.2051 of 2023 are the parents, brother and sisters-in-law of the Petitioner Nikunj.
The marriage of Respondent No.2 and the Petitioner Nikunj was solemnized on 3 May 2003.
They have a child from the said wedlock.
Respondent No.2 lodged the report on 10 November 2017 alleging that the Petitioners have subjected her to cruelty and misappropriated her stridhan and other valuables listed in the F.I.R.
